name: scanTypeNumber
description: Scan type number (1-99); see scanTypesPerRecord, byte 28, general header block 1

name: channelSetNumber
description: Channel set number (1-99).; See channelSetsPerScanType,  byte 29, general header block 1

name: channelType
description: Channel type identification (hex codes) - see documentation

name: channelSetStartTime
description: Channel set start time.

name: channelSetEndTime
description: Channel set end time.

name: samplesPerChannel
description: Number of samples ine ach trace of this channel set.

name: descaleMultiplier
description: Multiplier is used to descale the data to obtain input voltage in millivolts

name: numberOfChannelsThisSet
description: Number of channels in this channel set

name: samplingInterval
description: Sampling interval in microseconds.

name: arrayFormatting
description: Array formatting code. See documentation.

name: numberTraceHeaderExtensions
description: Number of trace header extensions. Must match byte 10 of Demux Trace Header.

name: extendedHeaderFlag
description: Set to 1 to indicate that extended header contains additional information on channel set.

name: channelGainControl
description: Channel gain control method - see documentation for code values.

name: verticalStack
description: Effective stack order. Set to one if no stack.

name: streamerNumber
description: Streamer cable number (required for streamer data only)

name: headerBlockType
description: Header block type. Set to 30 (hex) / 48 (decimal) for Channel Set Descriptor Block 1.

name: aliasFilterFrequency
description: Alias filter frequency in Hz

name: lowCutFilterFrequency
description: Low-cut filter setting in Hz

name: aliasFilterSlope
description: Alias filter slope in dB per octave. Zero indicates filter is out.

name: lowCutFilterSlope
description: Low-cut filter slope. Zero indicates filter is out.

name: notchFrequency
description: Notch frequency setting. The out filter is written as 0.0 Hz.

name: secondNotchFrequency
description: Second notch frequency.

name: thirdNotchFrequency
description: Third notch frequency.

name: filterPhase
description: Filter phase - see documentation for code meanings.

name: physicalUnit
description: Physical unit measured by this sensor - see documentation for code meanings.

name: headerBlockType2
description: Header block type. Set to 31 (hex) / 49 (decimal) for Channel Set Descriptor Block 2.

name: filterDelay
description: Signal delay introduced by the filter in microseconds

name: description
description: Channel set description (free-text).

name: headerBlockType3
description: Header block type. Set to 32 (hex) / 50 (decimal) for Channel Set Descriptor Block 3.
